recognize_zh: A 圖的嗜中性球核只分兩葉、呈夾鼻眼鏡狀（pince-nez），染色質極度凝集，屬假性 Pelger-Huët 變化；B 圖為細胞質空泡化、吞入紅血球與細胞碎片的巨噬細胞（噬血現象），兩者合併指向噬血性淋巴組織球增生症（HLH）中的暫時性類 Pelger 變化。
features: Mature neutrophil with a bilobed pince-nez nucleus connected by a thin chromatin strand (panel A)
Very coarsely clumped, dense nuclear chromatin in the bilobed nucleus
Neutrophil cytoplasm with fine pink-lilac granules, not markedly hypogranular
Large macrophage with abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm containing an engulfed red cell and purple nuclear debris (panel B)
Macrophage nucleus eccentric and oval with fine chromatin; background red cells
describe_en: Panel A shows a mature neutrophil with a bilobed, pince-nez-shaped nucleus composed of two round lobes joined by a thin bridge and markedly condensed chromatin, with retained cytoplasmic granulation, consistent with a pseudo-Pelger-Huët (pelgeroid) change. Panel B shows a large macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing engulfed red cells and nuclear debris, consistent with hemophagocytosis. Hypolobation in this setting may be acquired and transient, and should be judged against the proportion of affected neutrophils, prior counts, and other lineage dysplasia. Findings are consistent with transient pelgeroid neutrophil change accompanying hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, which requires correlation with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria.

ddx.vs: The inherited LBR-related anomaly affects most neutrophils persistently in an otherwise healthy person and family members, whereas this change is transient and disease-associated.
MDS-related pseudo-Pelger cells are usually hypogranular and accompanied by multilineage dysplasia, cytopenias, and clonal abnormalities that persist after the acute illness.
Mycophenolate, valproate, taxanes, or other drugs can produce identical hypolobated neutrophils, so medication history and resolution on withdrawal are needed to separate them.
